test_runs.selector: Row206 retry-isolation plus Row205 multi-binding compatibility
negative_cases: Scheduler-level restart flags are absent and cannot replay all bindings.
Terminal Goal tombstones bypass retry while exhausted failures kill-switch only their exact binding.

test_runs.selector: Goal, installer-registry, fallback-authority, and release-channel regression bundle
negative_cases: The Goal manager remains task-binding scoped and separate from installer release authority.
A fallback selector is not task identity and cannot authorize recovery.

test_runs.selector: PowerShell syntax, Python lint, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: PowerShell AST parse; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check tests/test_goal_recovery_retry_isolation.py tests/test_goal_recovery_multi_binding.py; git diff --check
test_runs.output: POWERSHELL_AST_PASS; All checks passed; diff check returned zero
negative_cases: No Goal helper, scheduled task, hook, tunnel, installer, HIL, pointer, candidate, or Git action was invoked.
Only source parsing and bounded static/regression tests ran.

limitations: Row206 implemented and tested the source contract without executing RecoverAtLogon or changing a live scheduled task or binding.
The two-second backoff exists only inside the isolated helper path and was not slept during this source-level verification.
The lowercase source locator resolves to the existing mixed-case Goal manager file and matches the native row's lowercase *goal*.* authority glob.
